test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 24 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate title for the passage.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Explanation:** The passage focuses on **India's renewable energy **ambitions and the **specific progress and challenges related to solar power.**
 
• It outlines the increase in installed capacities,** government initiatives, and economic factors affecting renewable energy.**
 
• The title** "Renewable Energy – Moving Forward" **aptly captures the essence of the passage, which is about the progress and future of renewable energy, particularly solar power.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electricity and Private Companies:** The passage does not focus on the role of private companies in the electricity sector; rather, it highlights government initiatives and sector-wide trends and challenges.
 
• **The World in Danger Zone:** While energy issues can be critical, this title is too broad and does not align with the specific focus on renewable energy progress in India.
 
• **Thermal Electricity – Difficulties:** Although the passage mentions the decline in thermal power's share, the primary focus is on the growth and potential of renewable energy, not just the challenges related to thermal electricity.
 
• In **summary**, **option 2** – "Renewable Energy – Moving Forward" – aptly encapsulates the main theme of the passage, which is about the advancements and future trajectory of renewable energy in India, particularly solar power. **Options 1, 3, and 4** either do not reflect the main focus or are too general/broad in scope.
